name: helper-module-initialization
goal: Preserve cold entrypoint initialization when colocating helpers and retaining public forwarding exports

evidence: Moving catalogFilter in 59f243b5 and retaining the public forwarding export in cbf84d62 created a module cycle. Browser startup and a native Bun cold import of the public entry fail because orders reads byName before its const initialization.

Existing catalog tests import the owner module first and reuse a warm Vitest graph. Extend the same standardized catalog suite with native fresh-runtime loading and a catalogFilter call through both public and owner entrypoints.

Test-only commit 20c7fdb5 fails a fresh public-entry import with the observed byName initialization error. Immutable red ec50fc3a2da3e9036451d2a72174be9ce243757ec8753aee090f476f6d37ae77 preserves the unchanged catalog suite and exact command.

Keep the comparator shared and public APIs intact; declare it as a hoisted function so either side of the forwarding cycle can initialize. The existing catalog suite must execute both entries in fresh native runtimes, and the helper-move review rule must require that coverage.

The shared comparator is now a hoisted declaration. Public forwarding exports and owner-local placement remain intact. The standardized catalog suite exercises native cold initialization through both entries; the existing helper-move skill checkpoint now requires that proof.

The unchanged native cold-entry catalog cases pass at b8321cd7. Immutable green f3db0abd11f4af6102bd280422c3448e727d5394d48dcd3e82e5bd0c0829bcf2 pairs with test-only red ec50fc3a2da3e9036451d2a72174be9ce243757ec8753aee090f476f6d37ae77 using the same tests, command and environment.

An isolated archive of b8321cd7 ran the unchanged standardized catalog suite. Reintroducing the previous constant comparator failed on the native byName initialization assertion; restoring the hoisted definition passed all nine cases. Logs: /tmp/harness-initialization-guard-{red,green}.log. No live preview or working source was mutated.
